result.summary: Found one visual issue: a restaurant name is clipped despite available space.

issues.description: The “Tokumaru Ramen” title under “Popular right now” is cut off mid-letter, leaving the final character incomplete despite ample space before the rating.
issues.suggestion: Increase the title container’s width or adjust its layout to display the full name. If truncation is necessary, use an ellipsis rather than clipping letters.
